items.html: *And behold, the matter of the breasts themselves is that they are drawn from the Name Elokim. For behold, the Nukva is called Elokim, as is known, and within her there is the Name Elokim in the GAR, and likewise in the three middle ones, and likewise in the three lower ones. And behold, the Name Elokim that is in her three middle ones is divided into three: Aleph-Lamed on the right, in the secret of 'Hesed El'; Mi on the left, for there is the secret of Bina, which is called Mi; therefore the secret of the Mi of Elokim is in the Gevura; and the Hei of Elokim is in the middle.
